description: Experience the rich culture of Japan with this 10-day itinerary, exploring ancient temples in Kyoto, vibrant city life in Osaka, the natural beauty of Sapporo, and the bustling metropolis of Tokyo. This trip focuses on cultural activities, historical sites, and local experiences.

days.title: Arrival in Kyoto & Cultural Immersion
days.description: Arrive in Kyoto and settle into your hotel. Begin your cultural journey with a language and culture crash course.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn basic Japanese phrases and cultural etiquette.What to bring: A notebook and pen are recommended for taking notes.What to eat: Try some local Japanese snacks after your class.Good to know: This course is great for solo travellers and provides a good foundation for your trip.

days.title: Exploring Historic Kyoto
days.description: Spend the day exploring the historic sites of Kyoto with a walking tour and visit local museums and galleries.

activities.activity_name: Historic Kyoto City Walking Tour — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll discover the rich history and beautiful architecture of Kyoto's historic districts.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a camera are highly recommended.What to eat: Sample traditional Japanese street food from local vendors.Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and offers a comprehensive overview of the city's heritage.

What you'll see: You'll gain access to a variety of museums and galleries showcasing Kyoto's art and history.What to bring: Your pass and a curious mind are all you need.What to eat: Enjoy a light snack at a museum cafe.Good to know: This pass is suitable for everyone and allows for flexible exploration of cultural institutions.

days.title: Kyoto Photography and Countryside
days.description: Capture the beauty of Kyoto's old town and then venture out for a day trip to the surrounding countryside.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll capture stunning images of Kyoto's traditional streets, temples, and gardens.What to bring: Your camera, extra batteries, and comfortable shoes are essential.What to eat: Grab a quick bite from a local bakery or cafe.Good to know: This tour is perfect for couples and solo travellers looking to enhance their photography skills.

What you'll see: You'll explore picturesque rural landscapes, traditional villages, and serene natural sites outside the city.What to bring: Comfortable shoes, water, and a camera are recommended.What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese lunch at a local countryside restaurant.Good to know: This day trip is suitable for everyone and offers a refreshing escape from the urban environment.

days.title: Travel to Osaka & City Exploration
days.description: Travel from Kyoto to Osaka. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and begin exploring Osaka's cultural offerings.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll gain access to various museums and galleries, showcasing Osaka's art and history.What to bring: Your pass and an interest in local culture.What to eat: Discover a local eatery near one of the museums.Good to know: This pass is suitable for everyone and offers a flexible way to explore cultural institutions.

days.title: Historic Osaka & Photography Tour

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore significant historical landmarks and learn about Osaka's past.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and water.What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese lunch at a local restaurant.Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and provides a great introduction to Osaka's heritage.

What you'll see: You'll capture the unique atmosphere and architecture of Osaka's old town.What to bring: Your camera, extra batteries, and a keen eye for detail.What to eat: Try some local street food while exploring.Good to know: This tour is ideal for couples and solo travellers interested in photography.

days.title: Travel to Sapporo & Cultural Exploration
days.description: Travel from Osaka to Sapporo. Check into your hotel and immerse yourself in Sapporo's cultural scene.
